farmer_equipment_source.name: farmer_equipment_source
farmer_equipment_source.value: ("farmer_equipment"."equipment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "farmer_equipment"."custom_name" IS NULL) OR ("farmer_equipment"."equipment_id" IS NULL AND "farmer_equipment"."custom_name" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("farmer_equipment"."custom_name") <> '')

farmers_location_nonempty.name: farmers_location_nonempty
farmers_location_nonempty.value: btrim("farmers"."region") <> '' AND btrim("farmers"."province") <> '' AND btrim("farmers"."municipality_city") <> '' AND btrim("farmers"."barangay") <> ''

farmers_coordinates.name: farmers_coordinates
farmers_coordinates.value: ("farmers"."latitude" IS NULL AND "farmers"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("farmers"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "farmers"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "farmers"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "farmers"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

farms_location_nonempty.name: farms_location_nonempty
farms_location_nonempty.value: btrim("farms"."region") <> '' AND btrim("farms"."province") <> '' AND btrim("farms"."municipality_city") <> '' AND btrim("farms"."barangay") <> ''

farms_coordinates.name: farms_coordinates
farms_coordinates.value: ("farms"."latitude" IS NULL AND "farms"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("farms"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "farms"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "farms"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "farms"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

ponds_coordinates.name: ponds_coordinates
ponds_coordinates.value: ("ponds"."latitude" IS NULL AND "ponds"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("ponds"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "ponds"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "ponds"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "ponds"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

stocking_cycles_harvest_status.name: stocking_cycles_harvest_status
stocking_cycles_harvest_status.value: ("stocking_cycles"."status" = 'harvested' AND "stocking_cycles"."actual_harvest_date" IS NOT NULL) OR ("stocking_cycles"."status" <> 'harvested' AND "stocking_cycles"."actual_harvest_date" IS NULL)

sensor_readings_bounds.name: sensor_readings_bounds
sensor_readings_bounds.value: "sensor_readings"."dissolved_oxygen_mg_l" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "sensor_readings"."ph" BETWEEN 0 AND 14 AND "sensor_readings"."water_temperature_c" BETWEEN -5 AND 60

action_valid.name: action_valid
action_valid.value: btrim("action_library"."instruction") <> '' AND "action_library"."effectiveness" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "action_library"."risk_type" IN ('low_oxygen','ph','temperature','weather_watch')

action_approval.name: action_approval
action_approval.value: "action_library"."approval_status" IN ('draft','approved','retired') AND ("action_library"."approval_status" <> 'approved' OR ("action_library"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("action_library"."reviewed_by") <> '' AND "action_library"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL))

advisory_ready_text.name: advisory_ready_text
advisory_ready_text.value: "advisories"."status" <> 'ready' OR ("advisories"."final_text" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("advisories"."final_text") <> '')

threshold_rule_valid.name: threshold_rule_valid
threshold_rule_valid.value: "threshold_rules"."version" > 0 AND "threshold_rules"."density_min" >= 0 AND "threshold_rules"."density_max" >= "threshold_rules"."density_min" AND "threshold_rules"."density_max" < 'Infinity'::float8 AND "threshold_rules"."do_min" BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND "threshold_rules"."ph_min" BETWEEN 0 AND 14 AND "threshold_rules"."ph_max" BETWEEN "threshold_rules"."ph_min" AND 14 AND "threshold_rules"."temperature_min" BETWEEN -5 AND 60 AND "threshold_rules"."temperature_max" BETWEEN "threshold_rules"."temperature_min" AND 60 AND "threshold_rules"."weather_rain_watch_mm" > 0 AND "threshold_rules"."weather_rain_watch_mm" < 'Infinity'::float8 AND "threshold_rules"."weather_heat_watch_c" BETWEEN -50 AND 60 AND "threshold_rules"."weather_wind_watch_kmh" > 0 AND "threshold_rules"."weather_wind_watch_kmh" < 'Infinity'::float8

threshold_rule_approval.name: threshold_rule_approval
threshold_rule_approval.value: "threshold_rules"."approval_status" IN ('draft','approved','retired') AND ("threshold_rules"."approval_status" <> 'approved' OR ("threshold_rules"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("threshold_rules"."reviewed_by") <> '' AND "threshold_rules"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL))
